chapter: Looking back and the New York years
title: Touring with Benny Carter
summary: Carter's band toured the same circuit including Florida; Carter was nice but would not lend money.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: When you were with Benny, did you also tour?
Where did you go with him?

We done the same thing. I think they must have had the same booking agent, because they went practically to the same towns, the same states. We made a circle, going right on back through Columbus, Ohio, Cleveland, and all through there, and come right on back to New York.
No. We went down to Florida.
But nowhere else on the way?
No, in Florida and ended up in Alabama, and then we come on across in Ohio.
Again, were you playing dance halls?
And these would all be White dance halls??
Yeah. White and Black. We played both.
What was Benny like to work for?

Oh, he's nice. He's all right. He was nice. He didn't want you to do too much to take the spotlight off him. None of them want that. They won't have that. But Benny, he was all right. Everybody for himself, though. He won't loan you no money. Won't let you have no money. If you just broke, you just broke.
You couldn't go to him for a loan.
